commit.message:
feat(FormalConjecturesForMathlib/GroupTheory): numerical invariants of groups and group actions (#6879)

Adds numerical invariants of finite groups and of group actions that are
not in Mathlib, as `ℕ`-valued definitions, so that inequalities between
group invariants can be stated.

**Invariants of a group** (`Group` namespace)

| File | Definitions |
|---|---|
| `GroupTheory/PrimeDivisors.lean` | `numPrimeDivisors`,
`largestPrimeDivisor` |
| `GroupTheory/DerivedLength.lean` | `derivedLength` |
| `GroupTheory/ElementOrders.lean` | `numElementOrders`,
`maxElementOrder`, `numInvolutions` |
| `GroupTheory/RationalClasses.lean` | `numRationalClasses`,
`numGaloisStableClasses` |
| `GroupTheory/SubgroupCounts.lean` | `numNormalSubgroups`,
`numMaximalSubgroupClasses` |
| `RepresentationTheory/CharacterDegree.lean` | `maxCharacterDegree` |

**Invariants of an action** (`MulAction` namespace; for `G ≤ Equiv.Perm
α`, of the permutation representation)

| File | Definitions |
|---|---|
| `GroupTheory/GroupAction/MovedPoints.lean` | `movedPoints`,
`numMovedPoints`, `minimalDegree` |
| `GroupTheory/GroupAction/OrbitCounts.lean` | `numOrbits`,
`numOrbitals` |
| `GroupTheory/GroupAction/TransitivityDegree.lean` |
`transitivityDegree` |
| `GroupTheory/GroupAction/InvolutionFixedPoints.lean` |
`minInvolutionFixedPoints`, `maxInvolutionFixedPoints` |

**Formalisation choices**

- Each docstring states the value in degenerate cases. `derivedLength`
is `0` for non-solvable groups (`sInf ∅`). `largestPrimeDivisor` and
`maxInvolutionFixedPoints` are `0` when nothing qualifies.
`transitivityDegree` only considers `k ≤ Nat.card α`: for finite `α`,
every action is `k`-transitive for `k > Nat.card α`. For infinite `α`,
`Nat.card α = 0`, so `transitivityDegree` is `0`.
- `numRationalClasses` counts conjugacy classes of cyclic subgroups.
`numGaloisStableClasses` counts the classes fixed by `g ↦ g ^ k` for `k`
coprime to the order of `g`.
- `maxCharacterDegree` is the largest `Module.finrank ℂ V` of a simple
`V : FDRep ℂ G`, since Mathlib has no API for character degrees.
- The sanity lemmas pin down these boundary cases, for example
`derivedLength_of_not_isSolvable`, `minInvolutionFixedPoints_le_card`
(the identity fixes every point), `numOrbits_eq_one` for transitive
actions, `numNormalSubgroups_pos`, and `transitivityDegree_of_infinite`.

**Checks**

- `lake --wfail build` passes for each new module, for
`FormalConjecturesForMathlib` and for `FormalConjecturesUtil`.
- There is no `sorry`, and each file imports only the Mathlib modules it
needs.

---------

Co-authored-by: Paul Lezeau <paul.lezeau@gmail.com>

+-/
+module
+
+public import Mathlib.GroupTheory.Solvable
+public import Mathlib.Order.Lattice.Nat
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+/-!
+# Derived length
+
+`Group.derivedLength G` is the length of the derived series of `G`: the least `k` with
+`derivedSeries G k = ⊥`, which exists exactly when `G` is solvable (`Group.IsSolvable`).
+-/
+
+namespace Group
+
+variable (G : Type*) [Group G]
+
+/-- The derived length of `G`: the least `k` with `derivedSeries G k = ⊥`. It is `0` if there is
+none, that is, if `G` is not solvable. -/
+noncomputable def derivedLength : ℕ := sInf {k : ℕ | derivedSeries G k = ⊥}
+
+
+theorem derivedLength_of_not_isSolvable (h : ¬ IsSolvable G) : derivedLength G = 0 := by
+  have : {k : ℕ | derivedSeries G k = ⊥} = ∅ :=
+    Set.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem fun k hk => h ⟨⟨k, hk⟩⟩
+  simp [derivedLength, this]
+
+theorem derivedLength_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton G] : derivedLength G = 0 :=
+  Nat.sInf_eq_zero.mpr (Or.inl (by simpa using Subgroup.eq_bot_of_subsingleton ⊤))
+
+example [IsSimpleGroup G] : derivedLength G = 1 ↔ IsMulCommutative G := by
+  rw [←commutator_eq_bot_iff, derivedLength, ←derivedSeries_one]
+  refine ⟨fun hk => ?_, fun hk => ?_⟩
+  · change 1 ∈ {k : ℕ | derivedSeries G k = ⊥}
+    rw [←hk]
+    apply Nat.sInf_mem (by grind [Nat.nonempty_of_pos_sInf])
+  · apply le_antisymm
+    · apply Nat.sInf_le
+      grind
+    · by_contra! h
+      change 1 ∈ {k : ℕ | derivedSeries G k = ⊥} at hk
+      grind [ Nat.sInf_eq_zero, derivedSeries_zero, top_ne_bot]
+
+end Group

+@[expose] public section

+/-!
+# Orders of elements
+
+* `Group.numElementOrders G`: the number of distinct orders of elements of `G`;
+* `Group.maxElementOrder G`: the largest order of an element;
+* `Group.numInvolutions G`: the number of elements of order `2`.

+namespace Group
+
+variable (G : Type*) [Group G]
+
+/-- The number of distinct orders of elements of `G`. -/
+noncomputable def numElementOrders : ℕ := (Set.range (orderOf : G → ℕ)).ncard

+noncomputable def maxElementOrder : ℕ := sSup (Set.range (orderOf : G → ℕ))

+noncomputable def numInvolutions : ℕ := {g : G | orderOf g = 2}.ncard

+  Set.ncard_le_card _

+module
+
+public import Mathlib.Data.Set.Card
+public import Mathlib.GroupTheory.GroupAction.Defs
+public import Mathlib.GroupTheory.GroupAction.FixedPoints
+public import Mathlib.GroupTheory.OrderOfElement
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+/-!
+# Fixed points of involutions
+
+* `MulAction.minInvolutionFixedPoints G α`: the least number of points fixed by an element of
+  order at most `2`;
+* `MulAction.maxInvolutionFixedPoints G α`: the largest number of points fixed by an involution.
+
+If `G` is the Galois group of a polynomial over $\mathbb{Q}$, acting on its complex roots, then
+complex conjugation restricts to an element of `G` of order at most `2`, and the real roots are
+the points that it fixes. So the number of real roots is at least `minInvolutionFixedPoints G α`.
+If some root is not real, complex conjugation has order `2`, and the number of real roots is also
+at most `maxInvolutionFixedPoints G α`. This upper bound needs a non-real root: the roots of
+$x^2 - 2$ are real and the only involution swaps them, so the maximum is `0`.
+-/
+
+namespace MulAction
+
+variable (G α : Type*) [Group G] [MulAction G α]
+
+/-- The least number of points fixed by an element of order at most `2`; it is `Nat.card α`
+if `G` has no involution, since the identity fixes every point. -/
+noncomputable def minInvolutionFixedPoints : ℕ :=
+  sInf {k : ℕ | ∃ g : G, g ^ 2 = 1 ∧ (fixedBy α g).ncard = k}
+
+/-- The largest number of points fixed by an involution (`0` if `G` has none). -/
+noncomputable def maxInvolutionFixedPoints : ℕ :=
+  sSup {k : ℕ | ∃ g : G, orderOf g = 2 ∧ (fixedBy α g).ncard = k}
+
+
+/-- The identity has order at most `2` and fixes every point. -/
+theorem minInvolutionFixedPoints_le_card [Finite α] :
+    minInvolutionFixedPoints G α ≤ Nat.card α :=
+  Nat.sInf_le ⟨1, one_pow 2, by rw [fixedBy_one_eq_univ, Set.ncard_univ]⟩
+
+end MulAction

+@[expose] public section
+
+/-!
+# Moved points and the minimal degree
+
+* `MulAction.movedPoints G α`: the points of `α` moved by some element of `G`;
+* `MulAction.numMovedPoints G α`: their number, the degree of a permutation group;
+* `MulAction.minimalDegree G α`: the least number of points moved by an element that moves one.
+-/
+
+namespace MulAction
+
+variable (G α : Type*) [Group G] [MulAction G α]
+
+/-- The points moved by some element of `G`. -/
+def movedPoints : Set α := {a : α | ∃ g : G, g • a ≠ a}
+
+/-- The number of points moved by some element of `G`. -/
+noncomputable def numMovedPoints : ℕ := (movedPoints G α).ncard
+
+/-- The least number of points moved by an element that moves some point (`0` if no element
+moves a point). -/
+noncomputable def minimalDegree : ℕ :=
+  sInf {k : ℕ | ∃ g : G, (fixedBy α g)ᶜ.Nonempty ∧ (fixedBy α g)ᶜ.ncard = k}
+
+
+@[simp]
+theorem movedPoints_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton G] : movedPoints G α = ∅ := by
+  ext a
+  simp [movedPoints, Subsingleton.elim _ (1 : G)]
+
+@[simp]
+theorem numMovedPoints_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton G] : numMovedPoints G α = 0 := by
+  simp [numMovedPoints]
+
+end MulAction

+# Numbers of orbits and orbitals

+* `MulAction.numOrbits G α`: the number of orbits of `G` on `α`, fixed points included;
+* `MulAction.numOrbitals G α`: the number of orbitals, the orbits of `G` on `α × α`; for a

+namespace MulAction

+variable (G α : Type*) [Group G] [MulAction G α]
+
+/-- The number of orbits of `G` on `α`, fixed points included. -/
+noncomputable def numOrbits : ℕ := Nat.card (orbitRel.Quotient G α)
+
+/-- The number of orbits of `G` on `α × α`. -/
+noncomputable def numOrbitals : ℕ := Nat.card (orbitRel.Quotient G (α × α))

+theorem numOrbits_eq_one [IsPretransitive G α] [Nonempty α] : numOrbits G α = 1 := by
+  rw [numOrbits, Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique]
+  refine ⟨⟨fun a b => Quotient.inductionOn₂ a b fun x y => ?_⟩,
+    ⟨Quotient.mk _ (Classical.arbitrary α)⟩⟩
+  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := exists_smul_eq G y x
+  exact Quotient.sound (orbitRel_apply.mpr ⟨g, hg⟩)
+
+end MulAction

+module
+
+public import Mathlib.GroupTheory.GroupAction.MultipleTransitivity
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+/-!
+# The degree of transitivity
+
+`MulAction.transitivityDegree G α` is the largest `k ≤ Nat.card α` such that the action of `G` on
+`α` is `k`-transitive (`MulAction.IsMultiplyPretransitive`). For finite `α`, every action is
+`k`-transitive for `k > Nat.card α`, because there is no injection `Fin k ↪ α`; hence the bound.
+For infinite `α`, `Nat.card α = 0`, so `transitivityDegree G α = 0`
+(`transitivityDegree_of_infinite`).
+-/
+
+namespace MulAction
+
+variable (G α : Type*) [Group G] [MulAction G α]
+
+/-- The largest `k ≤ Nat.card α` such that the action is `k`-transitive; it is `0` for infinite
+`α`. -/
+noncomputable def transitivityDegree : ℕ :=
+  sSup {k : ℕ | k ≤ Nat.card α ∧ IsMultiplyPretransitive G α k}
+
+
+theorem transitivityDegree_le_card [Finite α] : transitivityDegree G α ≤ Nat.card α :=
+  csSup_le' fun _ hk => hk.1
+
+/-- For infinite `α`, `Nat.card α = 0`, so the degree is `0`. -/
+theorem transitivityDegree_of_infinite [Infinite α] : transitivityDegree G α = 0 :=
+  Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero <| csSup_le' fun _ hk => by
+    simpa [Nat.card_eq_zero_of_infinite] using hk.1
+
+end MulAction

+-/
+module
+
+public import Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Conj
+public import Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Subgroup.Pointwise
+public import Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Subgroup.ZPowers.Basic
+public import Mathlib.Data.Set.Card
+public import Mathlib.GroupTheory.GroupAction.ConjAct
+public import Mathlib.GroupTheory.OrderOfElement
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+/-!
+# Rational classes and Galois-stable conjugacy classes
+
+The absolute Galois group of `ℚ` acts on the conjugacy classes of a finite group `G`: it maps the
+class of `g` to the class of `g ^ k` for `k` coprime to the order of `g`.
+
+* `Group.numRationalClasses G`: the number of orbits of this action on the conjugacy classes, the
+  rational classes; two elements are in the same rational class exactly when they generate
+  conjugate cyclic subgroups, so this is the number of conjugacy classes of cyclic subgroups;
+* `Group.numGaloisStableClasses G`: the number of conjugacy classes fixed by the action, the
+  classes on which every complex character of `G` takes rational values.
+-/
+
+open scoped Pointwise
+
+namespace Group
+
+variable (G : Type*) [Group G]
+
+/-- The number of rational classes of `G`, the conjugacy classes of its cyclic subgroups. -/
+noncomputable def numRationalClasses : ℕ :=
+  (Set.range fun g : G => MulAction.orbit (ConjAct G) (Subgroup.zpowers g)).ncard
+
+/-- The number of conjugacy classes of `G` that contain `g ^ k` together with `g` for every `k`
+coprime to the order of `g`. -/
+noncomputable def numGaloisStableClasses : ℕ :=
+  ((ConjClasses.mk : G → ConjClasses G) ''
+    {g : G | ∀ k : ℕ, k.Coprime (orderOf g) → IsConj g (g ^ k)}).ncard
+
+
+instance [Finite G] : Finite (ConjClasses G) :=
+  Finite.of_surjective _ ConjClasses.mk_surjective
+
+theorem numGaloisStableClasses_le [Finite G] :
+    numGaloisStableClasses G ≤ Nat.card (ConjClasses G) :=
+  Set.ncard_le_card _
+
+end Group

+module

+public import Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Subgroup.Pointwise
+public import Mathlib.Data.Set.Card
+public import Mathlib.GroupTheory.GroupAction.ConjAct
+public import Mathlib.Order.Atoms
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+/-!
+# Numbers of subgroups
+
+* `Group.numNormalSubgroups G`: the number of normal subgroups of `G`;
+* `Group.numMaximalSubgroupClasses G`: the number of conjugacy classes of maximal subgroups.
+-/
+
+open scoped Pointwise
+
+namespace Group
+
+variable (G : Type*) [Group G]
+
+/-- The number of normal subgroups of `G`. -/
+noncomputable def numNormalSubgroups : ℕ := {H : Subgroup G | H.Normal}.ncard
+
+/-- The number of conjugacy classes of maximal subgroups of `G`. -/
+noncomputable def numMaximalSubgroupClasses : ℕ :=
+  ((fun H : Subgroup G => MulAction.orbit (ConjAct G) H) '' {H : Subgroup G | IsCoatom H}).ncard
+
+instance [Finite G] : Finite (Subgroup G) :=
+  Finite.of_injective _ SetLike.coe_injective
+
+theorem numNormalSubgroups_pos [Finite G] : 0 < numNormalSubgroups G :=
+  (Set.ncard_pos (Set.toFinite _)).mpr ⟨⊥, Subgroup.normal_bot⟩
+
+example [Finite G] : 1 ≤ numNormalSubgroups G := by
+  exact (Set.ncard_pos (Finite.of_injective _ Subtype.coe_injective)).mpr
+    ⟨⊥, Subgroup.normal_bot⟩
+
+end Group

+@[expose] public section
+
+/-!
+# The largest character degree
+
+`Group.maxCharacterDegree G` is the largest degree of an irreducible complex character of `G`:
+the largest dimension of a simple finite-dimensional complex representation of `G`.
+-/
+
+namespace Group
+
+variable (G : Type*) [Group G]
+
+/-- The largest dimension of a simple finite-dimensional complex representation of `G`. -/
+noncomputable def maxCharacterDegree : ℕ :=
+  sSup {d : ℕ | ∃ V : FDRep ℂ G, CategoryTheory.Simple V ∧ Module.finrank ℂ V = d}

+end Group
